description: This file defines the ScopeRepository class implementing the ScopeRepositoryInterface to handle OAuth2 scope entities, with methods to retrieve and finalize scopes.

classes.name: ScopeRepository
classes.description: Implements scope management for OAuth2, providing methods to get and finalize scope entities.

methods.name: getScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieve a scope entity based on the provided identifier.

methods.name: finalizeScopes
methods.description: Finalize the list of scopes for a given client and grant type, currently returns the input scopes unmodified.
